tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: The brand ink. Logo, h1–h3, links, the topbar ground, footer headings, key numbers. On white 13.4:1, on mist 12.2:1, on sun 8.8:1, on yellow 10.7:1.

tokens.name: navy-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of the dark primary button and the open header search. White text on it 8.6:1.

tokens.name: teal-dark
tokens.usage: Overview (lead) paragraphs at the top of content pages, and the dark primary button fill. On white 6.1:1; white text on it 6.1:1.

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Hover colour for the logo and main navigation; the publication accent for eyebrows, standfirsts and timings. On white 6.1:1, on mist 5.7:1.

tokens.name: teal-bright
tokens.usage: Light primary button fill and the file-type badge behind document links. White text on it 4.7:1, so keep button text at 18px or larger.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Link hover and active colour, search-result titles, the current paginator page. On white 6.9:1.

tokens.name: blue-external
tokens.usage: The external-link icon and badge only. Not for text (5.0:1 on white, but reserved for the icon).

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Focus rings (2px solid outline), focused form borders, glossary terms, accordion chevrons. On white 5.9:1; a focus ring on mist 5.4:1.

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: Hover fill of the light primary button and the hover colour of light subtle buttons. Graphics only (1.8:1 on white). Publication range bars.

tokens.name: sun
tokens.usage: Quick exit bar, the accordion’s 4px left rule, focused form borders. Text on it is ink (6.9:1) or navy (8.8:1), never white.

tokens.name: sun-light
tokens.usage: Highlight behind a focused link and the quick exit bar’s border. Navy text on it 11.2:1.

tokens.name: yellow
tokens.usage: The “Get help now” pill only. Navy text on it 10.7:1.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Underline marking the current item in the topbar and main navigation. On navy 7.4:1.

tokens.name: seed
tokens.usage: The gold seed heads of the botanical illustration. In publications, used once to mark a moment on a chart.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text, h4–h6, accordion titles. On white 10.5:1, on sand 9.3:1, on mist 9.6:1.

tokens.name: slate
tokens.usage: Secondary text: breadcrumbs, alert copy, wayfinder copy, tile and section titles. On white 11.5:1, on surface 11.0:1.

tokens.name: slate-soft
tokens.usage: Hover text on featured links, image captions. On white 7.6:1.

tokens.name: placeholder
tokens.usage: Placeholder text in inputs. On white 4.7:1.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Page ground, cards, text on navy and teal-dark fills.

tokens.name: mist
tokens.usage: Header and footer ground, banner and hero panels, two-column card panels.

tokens.name: mist-2
tokens.usage: The enlarged logo mark on the homepage hero, and its watermark use in publications. Never behind text it would cut through.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Info alert ground, related-links panel on section pages.

tokens.name: ice
tokens.usage: Glossary tooltip ground and the banner “Get help now” card.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Card and featured-link ground, the light end of card gradients, page-action hover.

tokens.name: sand
tokens.usage: Accordion (closed) ground.

tokens.name: sand-hover
tokens.usage: Accordion hover ground and plain button ground.

tokens.name: sand-open
tokens.usage: Accordion ground once opened.

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: Search submit hover and support-provider tags.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Dividers, footer rules, card and alert borders. 1.5:1 on white: a separator, never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: control-line
tokens.usage: Reset-button border in search forms. 2.6:1 on white (below 3:1 in the source; kept exact).

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Form error borders and text, the alert site banner. On white 5.9:1.

tokens.name: error-bg
tokens.usage: Warning alert ground.

tokens.name: warning-icon
tokens.usage: Stroke of the warning triangle in warning alerts. On white 6.3:1.

tokens.name: notice-info
tokens.usage: Text on the info site banner. On sky 7.7:1.

tokens.name: notice-warning
tokens.usage: Text on the warning site banner. On white 7.6:1.

tokens.name: notice-warning-line
tokens.usage: Border of the warning site banner.

tokens.name: notice-alert
tokens.usage: Text on the alert site banner. On error-bg 7.6:1.

tokens.name: section-background-color
tokens.usage: Banner panel ground for the current section.

tokens.name: section-text-color
tokens.usage: Banner title and text. Blue: navy on mist 12.2:1; green: 12.8:1 on sky.

tokens.name: section-subtitle-color
tokens.usage: Merriweather subtitle above the page title in the banner. 8.4:1 (blue) and 8.2:1 (green) on its ground.

tokens.name: section-feature-color
tokens.usage: Accent for in-page links in the section: table of contents links, arrow links, guided-process fills. Blue 9.2:1 on white; green 5.9:1.

tokens.name: section-feature-color-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of the feature colour; also the “Get help now” hover fill with white text (13.4:1 blue, 6.9:1 green).

tokens.name: section-highlight-color
tokens.usage: Highlight ground in the section (selected guided-process answers).

tokens.name: section-illustration-color
tokens.usage: Flat fill of the botanical illustration in call-to-action blocks. Decorative only.

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Publication only: the one highlighted panel per page (engagement). Prefer sand on the web.

tokens.name: cream-line
tokens.usage: Publication only: rules inside the cream panel.

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: Publication only: list separators inside modules.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Publication only: notes, axis labels, comparison captions. On white 6.4:1, on cream 5.9:1. Prefer slate-soft on the web.

tokens.name: compare
tokens.usage: Publication only: the comparison series, always dashed or outlined, never colour alone. 3.4:1 on white (graphics, not text).

tokens.name: desk
tokens.usage: Publication only: the grey desk behind A3 sheets on screen.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Homepage hero title only, centred, navy. 40px below 576px, 56px from 576px.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page titles in the banner, navy. 28px / 1.39 below 1200px.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Serif section headings, alert titles and grouped-tile group names, navy. 24px / 1.33 below 1200px.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Content block headings (an h2 element carrying class h3), card titles, navy. 22px / 1.27 below 1200px.

styles.name: h4
styles.usage: Sub-headings in ink. 20px / 1.3 below 1200px.

styles.name: h5
styles.usage: Small headings in ink: table of contents, related links, wayfinder card title.

styles.name: h6
styles.usage: Run-in headings in ink, and the title of a compact alert.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: It is your right to make a formal complaint if you feel you haven’t been treated fairly.
styles.usage: The overview paragraph under a content page banner, in teal-dark. 18px below 1024px.

styles.name: intro-home
styles.sample: Whether something happened recently or in the past…
styles.usage: Homepage introduction only, in ink. 18px / 1.78 on phones, 22px / 2 from 1024px.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: If you are unhappy with how you have been treated, you can make a complaint.
styles.usage: All running text in ink. 16px below 1400px. Paragraph spacing 18px.

styles.name: body-small
styles.sample: Find more information about emergency contacts and crisis lines.
styles.usage: Card copy, alert copy (line height 1.75 there), footer links.

styles.name: link
styles.usage: Inline links: navy, bold, underlined; blue on hover; sun-light highlight on focus.

styles.name: nav
styles.usage: Main navigation items in navy, teal on hover. 18px on phones.

styles.name: accordion-title
styles.sample: For complaints about a government agency
styles.usage: Accordion summaries in ink. 18px / 1.33 below 1024px.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Topbar text, file metadata, compact alerts, glossary definitions. Never smaller than 12px.

styles.name: quick-exit
styles.usage: The quick exit bar only: uppercase, ink on sun.

styles.name: banner-subtitle
styles.usage: The section name above a page title, in section-subtitle-color. 18px / 1.56 below 1200px.

styles.name: toc-link
styles.usage: Table of contents links, in section-feature-color. 16px below 1024px.

styles.name: pub-title
styles.usage: Masthead title (24pt in print), navy.

styles.name: pub-headline

styles.usage: Feature headline (23pt; 25pt when wide, 28pt quarterly; steps down for long headlines).

styles.name: pub-number
styles.usage: Key numbers (23pt), tabular lining figures, navy.

styles.name: pub-section
styles.usage: Module titles (13pt) after the dot trio, navy.

styles.name: pub-kicker
styles.usage: Masthead kicker and feature eyebrow (10.5pt), teal.

styles.name: pub-standfirst
styles.sample: What people looked for, and what we changed.
styles.usage: Feature standfirst (11pt), teal.

styles.name: pub-body
styles.sample: Seventy-four of 115 pages were updated or added since the relaunch.
styles.usage: Publication body (9pt); steps to 8.6pt then 8.2pt only when a page is too full.

styles.name: pub-label
styles.usage: Labels, chart titles and small headings (8pt). Chart text 7.5pt; never below 7pt.
